installCommand: if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then ROOT='.'; elif [ -f ../pyproject.toml ]; then ROOT='..'; else echo 'pyproject.toml not found in . or ..'; exit 1; fi; cd "$ROOT" && uv pip install --system --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm ci
buildCommand: if [ -d frontend ]; then cd frontend; fi && npm run build && mkdir -p ../public && cp -r dist/* ../public/
